name: OmaSports
author: Miguel
description: All-in-one live sports tracker (Football, NBA, F1, NFL, MLB, NHL) on your Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Track live scores, team fixtures, and league standings across Football, NBA, F1, NFL, MLB, and NHL.

schema.label: Show live score ticker on bar
schema.description: Displays the live score of your favorite team directly on the status bar (e.g. ⚽ BEN 2-1 SPO 74'). Enabled by default.

schema.label: Update in background
schema.description: Keep fetching matches on the refresh interval even while the panel is closed, so the bar badge shows live games. Enabled by default.

schema.label: Panel position
schema.description: Where to render the sports panel relative to the bar icon. 'auto' centers if the icon is in the middle of the bar, or aligns below the icon if placed on the sides.
